context.app_name: Highlander Events — UCR Club Events App
decisions: S3 for image/video storage (event images, club logos, gallery photos)
AWS credentials already configured in .env (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION)
JWT auth — tokens must be validated on all protected routes

task.description: Set up the AWS S3 integration for image uploads and perform a security review of the backend API.

subtasks.title: Create S3 Bucket for Media
subtasks.description: Create an S3 bucket named 'highlander-events-media' (or similar) in us-east-1. Configure CORS for mobile uploads. Set up bucket policy for public read access on uploaded images. Add the bucket name to .env as S3_BUCKET.

subtasks.title: Implement S3 Upload Middleware
subtasks.description: Create apps/api-node/src/middleware/upload.js using multer-s3 and @aws-sdk/client-s3. Support image uploads (JPEG, PNG, WebP) up to 10MB. Generate unique S3 keys with UUID. Return the public URL. Wire it into POST /api/events and POST /api/clubs for image_url uploads.

subtasks.title: Security Review
subtasks.description: Review the backend code for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Check: SQL injection (parameterized queries), auth bypass, rate limiting, input validation, CORS configuration, JWT secret strength, error message leakage. Create a findings report at agents/handoffs/phase2-security-report.md.

subtasks.title: Add Presigned URL Endpoint (Optional)
subtasks.description: If direct S3 upload from mobile is preferred, create GET /api/upload/presign that returns a presigned S3 PUT URL. This allows the mobile app to upload directly to S3 without proxying through the API server.

acceptance_criteria: Image upload endpoint works (POST multipart/form-data → S3 URL returned)
S3 bucket name added to .env and .env.example
Security report generated with any findings + recommendations
No high-severity security issues in API code
CORS configured correctly on S3 bucket
constraints: Do NOT change the database schema
Do NOT modify the auth flow — JWT is working
Keep S3 bucket in us-east-1 to match existing AWS config
Follow the lab's security standards from CLAUDE.md
